optional_quality_limits: Persistent global incident strip draws attention above several task titles/results; retained H8 on those views.
Logs Add source and Refresh sources share outlined weight; labels and section grouping suffice, relative emphasis could be polished without adding a second filled action.
Expanded phone filter forms are compact and legible, but Activity result sits near the lower edge; D8 retained. Full-width native dates and content-sensitive spans remain appropriate.
Detail chronology wraps on phones; short diagnostic/action/fact sections create a somewhat fragmented scan, D8/Co8 retained. Semantic component differences and inline Checks are not required defects.
Backup has long small guidance and a busy setup-to-summary sequence; H/T/D/Co8 retained. Natural column heights and different semantic gaps are not independent defects.
Settings outer panels and generous MFA area add visual weight; H/T/D/Co8 retained.
Dark Appearance radios are less immediately inviting than light within otherwise clear preview cards; A8, no demonstrated required failure.
